description: Haarlemmerdijk gable shop houses of four storeys: 3.8-6.2 m fronts of red-brown or painted brick, a shop ground storey to about 4.4-4.9 m and three upper storeys of 2.5-2.9 m with white-framed windows, under a neck, bell or point gable whose foot stands at 11.5-12.5 m

match.note: Haarlemmerdijk 182 (2024-12-11, 1 m grid): rows 4.4-6.4 / 7.3-9.2 / 10.0-11.25 m, neck gable 11.8-14.6 m with scrolls; Haarlemmerdijk 8 (2022-12-15): rows 4.7-6.6 / 7.3-9.2 / 10.1-11.6 m under a point gable from 12.0 m. A separate type picked by reviewer type pins (the storey count is not readable from the eaves over a tall shop ground)

neck.note: Haarlemmerdijk 20 (167818): neck 10.2-12.9 m, 1.55 m wide, one attic light 10.4-11.6 m, scrolls not drawn

bell.note: Haarlemmerdijk 4 (176174): a bell/neck top about 10.3-12.8 m with one attic light

point.note: Haarlemmerdijk 8 (176101): a plain brick point gable 10.4-14.3 m over the full front with two attic lights

door-left.note: residential ground: house door on the left axis; shops come per pand from BAG/OSM (autoShopfront)

rhythm.windowsPerStorey: ground: a shop (BAG/OSM) or a house door and window | upper: 2 or 3
rhythm.groundFloor: a tall shop ground 4.4-4.9 m to the fascia top on the dijk and straat
rhythm.roofline: neck, bell or point gable with one or two attic lights
schemaLimits: the sandstone scrolls (klauwstukken) beside the neck are not drawn
